name: Blush Silk Wrap Dress
description: A fluid silk wrap dress in dusty rose, finished with a delicate self-tie sash. Cut to move beautifully from day into evening.

name: Ivory Linen Blazer
description: Tailored linen blazer in soft ivory with rose-gold buttons. A versatile layer for the modern atelier wardrobe.

name: Rosewater Pleated Skirt
description: Knife-pleated midi skirt in a muted rosewater tone, with a fluid drape that catches the light as you move.

name: Cloud Cashmere Sweater
description: An impossibly soft cashmere knit in warm blush, designed for an oversized, effortless silhouette.

name: Rose Gold Hoop Earrings
description: Hand-finished rose gold hoops with a subtle hammered texture, light enough for everyday wear.

name: Velvet Bow Hair Clip
description: A plush velvet bow clip in blush pink, the kind of small detail that finishes an entire look.

name: Pearl & Rose Gold Necklace
description: Freshwater pearls strung on a fine rose gold chain, layered for a soft, romantic neckline.

name: Blush Leather Mini Bag
description: A structured mini bag in buttery blush leather, with a detachable rose-gold chain strap.

name: Satin Hair Scrunchie Set
description: A set of three satin scrunchies in rose, cream, and champagne — gentle on hair, lovely on a wrist.

name: Rose Petal Scented Candle
description: Hand-poured soy candle in a reusable ceramic vessel, scented with rose petal and soft musk.

name: Atelier Gift Box
description: A curated keepsake box wrapped in blush ribbon, containing a candle, a hair accessory, and a handwritten card.

name: Linen Tote with Rose Embroidery
description: An ivory linen tote, hand-embroidered with a single rose motif. Roomy enough for everyday errands.

name: Rose Gold Jewelry Dish
description: A ceramic trinket dish with a hand-painted rose gold rim, perfect for rings and earrings at day's end.
